nodes.title: Final Result - DaSiWa Metadata Image Saver
Model tips
widgets_values:
## ANIMA

* select any anima model
* Textencoder: __qwen3_0.6b / qwen3_600m__
* Type: __qwen_image__
* VAE: __qwen_image_vae__
* 40+ steps ; CFG 3.5 

## ILLUSTRIOUS
* select any illustrious model
* Textencoder: idk its built it probably dont ask me this shit just works somehow
* VAE: baked in probably?
* steps and cfg consult model page i use 30-35 and like 4.5

## KREA2

* select any Krea2 model
* Textencoder:__qwen3vl_4b__
* Type: __krea2__
* VAE: __qwen_image_vae__
* TURBO 8 steps ; CGF 1
* RAW 50+ steps ; CFG 3.5

### Requirements
- [ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes](https://github.com/darksidewalker/ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes)
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)

### Usage
- Enhanced Upscaler nodes
- Multi-Pass fixes
- Anima + Krea2 compatibility

## ANIMA

For Anima select any anima model + qwen3_0.6b textencoder

[ANIMA Model](https://civitai.red/models/2627349/dasiwa-anima)

[Text_Encoder Qwen3_0.6b / qwen3_600m](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors?download=true)

[VAE qwen_image_vae](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors?download=true)

## KREA2

For Krea2 select any Krea2 model + qwen3vl_4b textencoder

[KREA2 Model](https://civitai.red/models/2760803/dasiwa-krea2)

[Text_Encoder Qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true)

[VAE qwen_image_vae](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors?download=true)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 unet/
│   │   └── *.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen*.safetensors 

```
